questions.questionText: Disruption in the supply chains of essential goods and shortages of key medical products during the global health crisis have highlighted the links between countries and renewed the debate on the advantages and disadvantages of specialisation. Define the term ‘specialisation’.

Disruption in the supply chains of essential goods and shortages of key medical products during the global health crisis have highlighted the links between countries and renewed the debate on the advantages and disadvantages of specialisation. Explain one likely advantage of specialising in the production of goods to trade.

The world’s first cryptocurrency, Bitcoin is stored and exchanged securely on the internet through a digital ledger known as a blockchain. Bitcoins are divisible into smaller units known as satoshis. Which one of the following would be most likely to cause a country’s currency to no longer be acceptable as a medium of exchange?
options: It is issued in smaller denominations

questions.questionText: The world’s first cryptocurrency, Bitcoin is stored and exchanged securely on the internet through a digital ledger known as a blockchain. Bitcoins are divisible into smaller units known as satoshis. Explain how Bitcoin fulfils one function of money, apart from as a medium of exchange.
Discuss the likely impacts on an economy of specialising in the fishing industry. Use a production possibility frontier diagram in your answer.

Henry Ford designed his first moving assembly line in 1913, and revolutionised the car production process of the Ford Model T. This assembly line, at the first Ford factory, became the benchmark for mass production methods around the world. The benefits of specialisation and division of labour are mostly associated with:

Henry Ford designed his first moving assembly line in 1913, and revolutionised the car production process of the Ford Model T. This assembly line, at the first Ford factory, became the benchmark for mass production methods around the world. Explain one advantage of the division of labour in car production.

Free market economics is being challenged. The arguments for and against are being increasingly discussed within many countries. Adam Smith described the benefits of specialisation and the division of labour. Explain one advantage to a firm of using division of labour when organising its production process.
Which one of the following is the most likely consequence of an increase in the division of labour in the production of smartphones?
options: Decrease in boredom for smartphone workers
Decrease in use of specialised manufacturing equipment
Decrease in the cost per unit of smartphones
Increase in training costs per worker

questions.questionText: Explain what function money has in improving specialisation in the production of smartphones.
